name: html-paragraph-mixed-image-text-stays-html
description: Negative guard for paragraph-wrapped image conversion: a paragraph that carries an image plus real text is genuinely mixed content and stays core/html. It must not be silently restructured into a core/image that would drop the surrounding words.

source_reference.notes: Boundary for #2017. Convert only when the paragraph's content is a single image ignoring insignificant whitespace.

legacy_comparison.reason: Negative guard for new paragraph-wrapped image conversion.
